title: A conversion route slot always holds a previously approved route that avoids the market's pool and shares no dependency with the other slot (disable clears only the flag, restore admits only an approved address); a token's primary, alternate and standby share no feed, are defined and primary and standby legs are hourly, so the routes in force share no feed and the primary in force is hourly; replacedSlot is None at listing

useStandbyRoute succeeds only for the pause guardian or the timelock, onto the Primary or Alternate slot of a listed token with a non-empty standby, no active switch, every standby leg defined and, for Primary, hourly; otherwise it reverts with the REQ-MREG-028 error; a second switch always reverts

priceRouteVersion rises by exactly one on every successful setPriceSource, useStandbyRoute, cancelStandbySwitch and restorePriceRoute and on nothing else; every change of the routes in force (activePriceRoutes) comes with an increment

useStandbyRoute: pause guardian (immediate) or timelock (short, DAO-only cancel); cancelStandbySwitch: only the Aave governance executor, immediate, never a timelock operation; restorePriceRoute: only APPLICATION_ADMIN, not short-eligible, so at the normal delay

activePriceRoutes substitutes the standby into the replaced slot only: the other slot is its recorded route, None gives the recorded pair, and switch, cancel and restore never change the recorded primary, alternate or standby
